description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer, surrogate, and copier for ImmutableSortedDictionary<TKey, TValue> in the Orleans serialization framework. It defines how to serialize, deserialize, and deep copy ImmutableSortedDictionary instances, including surrogate types and associated helper classes.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer class for ImmutableSortedDictionary, handling conversion to and from surrogate representations.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ImmutableSortedDictionary instances.

classes.name: ImmutableSortedDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier class for ImmutableSortedDictionary, supporting deep copy operations.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate representation back into an ImmutableSortedDictionary.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts an ImmutableSortedDictionary into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of an ImmutableSortedDictionary, optionally using provided key and value copiers.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Indicates whether the copier can perform shallow copies.
